info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Create Parking Reservations Checkin-v3-spec
info.description: The Parking Reservations Check-In API facilitates the seamless check-in process for parking reservations. It allows users to confirm their arrival and secure their reserved parking spot upon reaching the facility. This API is primarily used by parking management systems and mobile applications to enhance user experience by providing instant confirmation of check-in. Typical consumers include parking service providers and customers seeking efficient management of their parking reservations.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to check in to their existing reservations, confirming their arrival and updating the reservation status accordingly.

requestBody.description: This request body is used for checking in a reservation. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly to facilitate a successful check-in process.

amount.description: The total amount of the reservation.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is specified.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required.

requestedAt.description: The timestamp when the check-in was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the check-in request is made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record within the reservation system.
